scope: Public documentation and enabled browser-tab inventory only. No accounts, purchases, downloads, paid API calls or outcome access.

barchart.evidence: Official search-index extracts describe membership tiers, general CSV downloads and historical export limits. Direct pages returned a JavaScript/bot verification page.
barchart.not_established: No current account entitlement, remaining quota or zero-cost expired NQ contract minute export confirmed. No existing Barchart tab on enabled browser surfaces.

firstrate.evidence: FAQ offers two weeks of recent sample data and no samples outside its listing. License permits derivative research outputs, not raw redistribution.
firstrate.not_established: No free multi-year per-contract sample archive; actual sample contract chain and complete warmup not certified.

algoseek.evidence: Public page advertises up to one year of sandbox history without a credit card.
algoseek.not_established: Exact NQ dataset, dates and export entitlement in the user's account; prior Contact Us screen remains unresolved.

databento.evidence: Official FAQ: $125 credits for new users, one per team, six-month expiry; historical usage-based data has no monthly subscription fee. Billing documentation: unlimited default absent a monthly limit; blocks requests after usage exceeds a configured limit.
databento.not_established: User eligibility, quote, payment obligations, instrument licensing, remaining credits and a guaranteed zero-out-of-pocket request guard. No account activated.

cme.evidence: Settlement page supplies daily contract statistics as reference, not the needed exact intraday anchor bars.
cme.not_established: No tick-level 15:00 fill or one-minute timestamp certification from daily settlements.
